remote_cram_transport.source_checksum_semantics: declared upstream identity; not locally verified for streamed full CRAM

wgs.extraction: mate-aware; retain chr6 MHC and HLA-A/B/C alternate contigs

wes.extraction: end-to-end rerun; no reuse of pre-correction normalized calls

rnaseq.input: frozen paired bulk RNA-seq FASTQ manifest
rnaseq.extraction: end-to-end rerun; no reuse of pre-correction normalized calls

caller_configuration.HLA-HD: pin command, reference bundle, container digest, threads and memory before execution
caller_configuration.Kourami: pin command, graph/reference bundle, container digest, threads and memory before execution
caller_configuration.OptiType: pin command, data type, container digest, threads and memory before execution
caller_configuration.POLYSOLVER: IPD-IMGT/HLA 3.11.0; pinned container and wrapper source; region-plus-unmapped input; audited hg38 6/chr6 wrapper compatibility transform v1; threads and memory frozen by workflow
caller_configuration.SpecHLA: pin command, Git commit, wrapper checksum, threads and memory before execution
caller_configuration.T1K: pin command, index checksum, container digest, threads and memory before execution
caller_configuration.ArcasHLA: pin command, reference bundle, container digest, threads and memory before execution

bam_contig_compatibility.policy: Every BAM region extraction uses the workflow-locked literal-field detector and requires exactly one primary chromosome-6 name, 6 or chr6.

fail_closed: missing or empty native caller output

denominators.change_rule: only a separately documented truth-eligibility defect can create a new versioned denominator
